skill.name: nex-favv-food-pack
skill.description: Builds FAVV registration decision trees, EU 1169/2011 label checklists, HACCP plans, allergen matrices, and recall workflows for Belgian food businesses. Use when: Determine if you need a FAVV registration, permit, or approval; Create EU 1169/2011 compliant food labels in Dutch; Build HACCP and autocontrole structures for small kitchens.
skill.summary: Draft Dutch food compliance documents for Belgian businesses, covering FAVV status, labels, HACCP, allergens, and recalls.
skill.author: nexaiguy

content.value_statement: Belgian food businesses need clear documents for registration, labeling, hygiene, allergens, and recalls. This guide helps Claude and Codex draft Dutch working documents for review.
actual_capabilities: Guides FAVV registration, authorization, and approval discussions using business activity, product group, and scale.
Drafts EU 1169/2011 label checklists covering mandatory mentions, nutrition table order, font sizes, and potential exemptions.
Outlines HACCP and autocontrole plans around seven principles and relevant sector guides, including G-044.
Structures allergen matrices covering the 14 Annex II allergens for non-prepacked food.
Outlines recall steps covering stock blocking, traceability, LCE reporting, consumer notices, and corrective records.
Supports Dutch document drafts for Belgian food businesses.
limitations: Covers Belgian and EU contexts, not other jurisdictions.
Provides working drafts, not FAVV-approved documents or guaranteed legal compliance.
Contains only a public guide; original scripts, extension source, templates, and the claimed verified facts section are not included.
The guide claims June 2026 coverage; current requirements, activity classifications, and exemptions need independent verification.

use_cases.title: Prepare a bakery launch review
use_cases.description: Outline possible FAVV status and label requirements from a bakery's products, sales channels, and operating scale.

use_cases.title: Organize kitchen safety documents
use_cases.description: Draft a HACCP structure and allergen matrix for review against recipes, supplier information, and the relevant sector guide.

use_cases.title: Prepare a recall procedure
use_cases.description: Structure stock blocking, distribution tracing, LCE reporting, customer communication, and corrective records for a product recall.

prompt_templates.title: Identify FAVV questions
prompt_templates.prompt: I plan to sell [products] through [channels] in Belgium at [scale]. Explain possible FAVV statuses and list missing information before recommending next steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: preparing an initial registration discussion

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Dutch label checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Dutch label checklist for [prepacked product] using [ingredients], [package size], and [sales channels]. Flag missing facts and exemptions needing official verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: reviewing a product label draft

prompt_templates.title: Structure HACCP and allergens
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [process steps], [recipes], and [supplier allergen data] to draft a HACCP outline and Dutch allergen matrix. Separate confirmed facts from missing information.

prompt_templates.title: Build a recall exercise
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [batch records], [distribution records], and [incident facts], draft a Belgian recall exercise. Include stock blocking, traceability, LCE reporting, customer notices, and corrective records.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: testing an incident response workflow

best_practices: Provide exact products, ingredients, processes, sales channels, and operating scale before requesting a draft.
Check current FAVV guidance, EUR-Lex requirements, and the applicable sector guide before using any recommendation.
Have a qualified reviewer verify classifications, exemptions, allergen information, and safety procedures before implementation.
anti_patterns: Treating generated documents as FAVV approval or proof of compliance.
Applying label exemptions or registration conclusions without checking the specific activity and current conditions.
Inferring allergen absence from incomplete recipes or supplier information.

faq.question: Does this skill provide FAVV approval?
faq.answer: No. It helps draft documents and questions for review. Official status and compliance require the appropriate checks and procedures.

faq.question: Can it produce documents in Dutch?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide emphasizes Dutch outputs for Flemish food businesses.

faq.question: Which businesses does it address?
faq.answer: The guide covers Belgian small producers, hospitality businesses, B2B suppliers, and webshops.

faq.question: Are scripts and reusable templates included?
faq.answer: No. The supplied package contains only SKILL.md. Scripts, extension source, and templates from the original package are absent.

faq.question: Are the regulatory details current?
faq.answer: The guide claims June 2026 coverage. Verify current FAVV pages, EUR-Lex texts, and sector guidance before applying its advice.

faq.question: Can it determine my required FAVV status?
faq.answer: It can structure the assessment using activity, products, and scale. Confirm the result against current official requirements before applying.
